messages:
ana: Spotting a 5xx spike on embeddings since 04:50 UTC, migration sidecar appears stuck. Requesting expedited hotfix to restart worker and flip MIGRATION_FLAG. Need SRE + Product approvals. Preferred window 05:15-05:45 UTC. deploybot, intake?

deploybot: Intake confirmed for service=embeddings. Hotfix proposal: image=redwood/embeds:2026.03-hotfix-migB, canary=10% for 5m. Approvals required: @chris (SRE) + @dave (Product). Provide runbook and rollback criteria.

chris: Oncall SRE here. Share rollback one-liner and abort thresholds; will run staging smoke.

ana: Runbook (short): 1) Kick canary 10% for 5m. 2) Monitor errors via /dash?svc=embeds&window=5m and logs for sidecar panics. Abort if errors >0.9% OR p95 increases >180ms. 3) Rollback: `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/embeds embeds=redwood/embeds:2026.03-stable && kubectl rollout status deploy/embeds`. 4) Post release note.

dave: Product ack, no schema change. Release note draft: "Hotfix: restart embeddings worker and toggle migration flag to address intermittent 5xxs. No API changes."

chris: Staging smoke passed at 05:08 UTC, KV warm and latency within baseline. Will approve after canary looks good.

deploybot: Manual gate created. To approve run `/deploy approve 6177777000 --by @chris` and `/deploy approve 6177777000 --by @dave`. Kick with `/deploy kick 6177777000 --window 05:15-05:45 --manual-gate`.

monica: Ops will watch metrics and open the bridge at kick.

ana: Kicking canary 05:16 UTC (cb-6177777000). Initial canary: errors=0.11%, p95 +28ms.

chris: Canary green, `/deploy approve 6177777000 --by @chris`

dave: Approving from Product, `/deploy approve 6177777000 --by @dave`

deploybot: Both approvals received. Promoting to 100% at 05:21 UTC. Rolling update in progress.

deploybot: Rollout complete 05:24 UTC. Post-rollout metrics: errors stayed ~0.1%, p95 stable. No rollback executed.

opsbot: Monitoring window +20m active. No regressions observed.

ana: Posting release note and closing thread after monitoring. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
